verdict.rationale: Google's Workspace pricing page lists 'Appointment booking pages' as a Google Calendar feature, which is the product's own capability for this story. However, the evidence is only a single line-item mention. The free/busy API is a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of a shareable booking link, invitee self-selection of slots from live availability, conflict checking against existing events, booking confirmation flow, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can share a booking link where invitees pick a time from my live availability — no back-and-forth email
